text:
No tree-cover loss of 0.5 hectares or more was detected on the asset between 2021 and 2025, with valid observations across the whole property. The JRC reference map also shows no forest on the asset in 2020.

This supports a finding of no **detected** post-baseline loss, but it does not establish that the asset is deforestation-free or compliant with any regulation. Smaller changes, narrow features or changes at boundaries may have been missed.
